args.message:
Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

CVE-2026-31337 (high): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested
arrays in fastjson < 2.9.4. Bump to the fixed 2.9.4 release.

args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 in `requirements.txt` to address **CVE-2026-31337** (high severity: unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays, affecting fastjson < 2.9.4).

Fix versions per the advisory: 2.9.4 (2.x line) or 3.1.0. We stay on the 2.x line with the minimal bump.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit c8b8ab7878: **passed**

cc @alex for review
